Root cause investigation found three layered bugs: (1) llm-resolver-vessel advertised 'llmCompletion' (camelCase) but handler registered under 'llm_completion' (snake_case) — discovery clients got 404; (2) callers passed 'anthropic/claude-...' but Anthropic SDK requires bare names; (3) dev-vessel llm_completion_dispatch resolver queried wrong shape name. All three fixed in iter-29. Direct POST to llm-resolver-vessel now works with real token counts. HOWEVER: the activity execution path STILL produces 0 tokens post-fix. Engine's llm-prompt resolver is invoked but apparently doesn't reach llm.generate(). Deeper engine-level investigation needed.
